description: Maki's Homebrew formula and the Devin CLI and Warp Agent CLI casks, installed and not run.
why: Nothing else on this machine names any of the three agents, so each Homebrew token is its only witness. windsurf is forbidden because its cask is devin-desktop, and the devin-cli token must not be read as it. The Warp Agent CLI cask links its binary as `warp` under Homebrew's prefix, not ~/.local/bin, so the warp-agent-cli token is its witness alone.
